title: Release A, finishing: the work the rush of 12 November cut short
problem: To go live on 12 November the screens, the text and the stamp book were built by eight helpers in a few hours, with small faults listed as known gaps (REP-111, REP-112), checks left NOT RUN, dead code left behind, and some documents out of date.
scope: The day's screens: the bottom bar and the doubled sound at the bell, first-game tips on a small phone, rows under a sheet closed to keyboard and screen reader, the evening favour card's board words, the night's hint, your own rush line, dead code and styles, the Favoured Trade step in the QA sweep

The stamp book: the collection opens full cards, the boards' button words on Results and Home, a granted look kept at sync, sounds proven to reach the player, old styles, the checks never run (pass-and-play to the results, the Wardrobe online, reduced motion, the opening animation)
RULES.md's words in step with the cards (words only)
The print kit rebuilt from the final card text; the pages never looked at, looked at
Documents: the creative bible's setting and cast, the game brief, the store listing and the online notes about accounts
The Play store screenshots regenerated; the helpers' old work folders cleared
Records: the owner's look at the screens; STATE.md back to about 500 words
exclusions: Any rule, number, balance, save or message change
